name: Red Gunpowder
description: A modern Indian restaurant located in Pererenan, Bali, known for its contemporary take on Indian cuisine in a stylish, reclaimed-wood setting with a garden terrace. Dishes include tandoor octopus, butter chicken, creative cocktails and special events.
priceRange: Small plates from Rp 110.000; mains Rp 120.000-195.000; signature cocktails Rp 140.000++
